claims.claim: Intersect's TSC requests $298,250, stated as 1,193,000 ADA, to support TSC activities for 12 months.
The proposal breaks the 1,193,000 ADA budget into WP1 at 256,000 ADA, WP2 at 832,000 ADA, and WP3 at 105,000 ADA.
All expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds will be returned to the Cardano treasury.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.

The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The requested withdrawal does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

Independent audits and assurance for this proposal will be provided by Appold, with reviews that may include deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone evidence assessment.

The Technical Steering Committee has not received Cardano Treasury funding within the past 24 months, while Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA through listed prior governance actions.
Treasury funds will be administered through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts using a TRSC and one PSSC with specified stake/payment addresses and multi-party authorization roles.
The TSC's work is claimed to support Cardano's technical governance infrastructure, protocol evolution, DRep decision-making, and ecosystem resilience across all five stated strategic pillars.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for 12 months of Intersect TSC support, with budgeted work packages, stated audit and smart-contract controls, prior-funding disclosure, and references for Hydra voting, NCL compliance, and treasury-contract verification.
